title: JANUS Ocean public-source prospective NOAA and drand with hypothetical SUNLU Glow sensor

lane_009a.title: OPEN-LIGHT-009A — prospective NOAA irradiance
lane_009a.real_observation_source: NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory SURFRAD Bondville, IL
lane_009a.real_observed_quantity: global horizontal downwelling shortwave solar irradiance GHI W/m^2
lane_009a.quality_gate: All 1440 unique minute rows, QC flag zero for GHI, >=45/60 per hour, 24 complete hours for each day. Failure is reported, never filled with zero or omitted.
lane_009a.training_days: Four predetermined calendar days D-7 through D-4 where D is early preparation UTC date
lane_009a.early_schedule_utc: 03:17 UTC on preparation date D, target D+2
lane_009a.target_disclosure: Do not retrieve target day until >=3 days after start of target day; late verification 03:17 UTC target+3 days
lane_009a.github_precommit: Publish all 24 forecast and each baseline into unique date-named GitHub Actions artifact with immutable server-side creation timestamp before first target minute. Fail if duplicate.
lane_009a.primary_metric: Mean absolute error W/m^2 across all 24 predeclared target hours, with all 8 days pooled if complete
lane_009a.hypothesis: Physics-informed fixed hybrid generalizes better than each comparator on unseen public NOAA data.
lane_009a.source_hash_policy: Store exact NOAA daily original SHA-256 bytes and retrieved publication time; distinguish later NOAA corrections.

lane_009b.title: OPEN-FUTURE-009B — independent future drand public randomness
lane_009b.provider: drand Quicknet BLS signed public randomness
lane_009b.verifier: drand-client@1.4.2; mandatory BLS signature verification against pinned chain key, and SHA256(signature) equals declared randomness
lane_009b.target_bit: most significant bit of SHA256(verified round signature)
lane_009b.early_schedule: 11:37 UTC two calendar days before target date, publish exact model output probabilities and bit decisions in unique dated GitHub Actions artifact before future target
lane_009b.late_schedule: 12:48 UTC on target date, fetch exact originally frozen artifact, check GitHub server time before first round, verify 128 unfiltered signed rounds, score ALL bits
lane_009b.model: JanusTinyTransformer reused from immutable historical synthetic Born-rule project, not trained on drand and no retraining in this experiment

hypotheses.H0: The predicted bits are independent of cryptographically unpredictable future drand bits; expected matches=512/1024.
hypotheses.H1_exploratory: The frozen model matches more than chance (test only on complete fixed calendar).

metrics: raw bit accuracy across all fixed slots
exact two-sided per-cohort binomial descriptive only
single pooled one-sided binomial probability on 1024
lane_009b.strict_conditions: Threshold has interpretive meaning only if 8 complete cohorts were frozen before target timestamps, verified without omission or multiple tested targets. Scientific anomaly requires independent replication and conventional leakage controls.

lane_009c.title: OPEN-GLOW-009C — hypothetical afterglow physical-memory adapter
lane_009c.compound: SrAl2O4:Eu2+,Dy3+ representative green persistent luminescence, NOT independently confirmed dopant concentrations in every SUNLU PLA product
lane_009c.formulation_scope: 2023 SDS only; nominal published fraction, not an independently measured current spool.
lane_009c.note_on_decay: Published kinetics often require multiple exponentials and show average lifetimes of approx 750-1780 s under particular laboratory excitation; 900 s is a scenario assumption, not manufacturer characterization.
lane_009c.radiation_spectral_limitation: NOAA GHI is broadband; 3% is an invented conversion fraction used ONLY as a sensitivity scenario and not measured UV spectrum.
lane_009c.prospective_control: Freeze virtual green-output 24-hour trace from OPEN-LIGHT-009A future GHI predictions before target. After real NOAA GHI release, calculate a second virtual trace under identical assumed constants, compare MAE; never call it measured glow.
controls_for_real_material_future: photodiode optical collection and gain calibration
temperature compensation and repeated known-duration charge/discharge

security_and_provenance.independent_timestamp: Github Actions artifact created_at. Platform timestamp, not hardware clock.
security_and_provenance.missing_release_policy: FAIL_CLOSED_KEEP_UNKNOWN_AND_REVIEW; never count as zero or skip unfavorable cases
security_and_provenance.result_policy: Append outcomes as separate JSON after actual verified run ID, SHA, source provenance; never overwrite this preregistration
security_and_provenance.data_residency: only public datasets + model checkpoint; no private personal data or NAS devices

next_gate: Observe first 009A/009B forecast artifacts timestamped BEFORE their targets; assess only after 2026-11-12. Assess SUNLU actual material only after separate controlled hardware measurements.
